title: The Content Fortress and the AI Personal Assistant
description: Steven describes building a "content fortress" with AI, why Meta's Muse could finally automate his social media posting and email follow-ups, and what AI still can't do, from Halloween storytelling to replacing real podcast hosts. He also questions venture-funded AI business models and uses one of his ten new dashboards to look at how China's Fifth Plenary Session may affect stocks.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content Overview

sentences.zh: 这期节目，史蒂文聊了他用 AI 堆出来的一大摞内容，还有 Meta 的 Muse 为什么可能成为他下一个要买的 AI 工具。
sentences.en: In this episode, Steven talks about the huge pile of content he has churned out with AI, and why Meta's Muse could become the next AI tool he buys.

sentences.zh: 他还谈到靠风险投资养活的 AI 公司、上周的万圣节朗读，以及 AI 目前还做不到的事。
sentences.en: He also discusses AI companies kept alive by venture capital, last week's Halloween reading, and the things AI still can't do.

sentences.zh: 最后，他借着自己新做的十个数据看板之一，看了看中国的重要党内会议和股市。
sentences.en: Finally, using one of the ten data dashboards he recently built, he takes a look at China's important Party meetings and its stock market.

sentences.zh: 开场时他还把日期说错了。
sentences.en: He also got the date wrong at the start of the show.

sentences.zh: 欢迎来到十一月！
sentences.en: Welcome to November!

sentences.zh: 一座“内容堡垒”
sentences.en: A "content fortress"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文又在 TikTok 上直播了。
sentences.en: Steven is livestreaming on TikTok again.

sentences.zh: 过去两周，他一直在拼装一座所谓的“内容堡垒”，想让社交媒体上到处都是他的脸和声音。
sentences.en: For the past two weeks, he has been assembling a so-called "content fortress," aiming to have his face and voice all over social media.

sentences.zh: 他甚至注册了 Snapchat，尽管上面一个熟人都没有。
sentences.en: He even signed up for Snapchat, despite not knowing a single person on it.

sentences.zh: 原因是他听说，今天喂给社交媒体的内容，会成为明天大语言模型记住你的“种子”。
sentences.en: The reason is that he has heard that the content you feed social media today will become the "seeds" that large language models remember you by tomorrow.

sentences.zh: AI 准备的东西都要他亲自过目，所以他自己成了瓶颈：“我就是那道关卡。”
sentences.en: Everything the AI prepares has to be reviewed by him personally, so he himself has become the bottleneck: "I am the checkpoint."

sentences.zh: 为什么不干脆做科技博主？
sentences.en: Why not just become a tech blogger?

sentences.zh: 他想过，但他不在技术最前沿，也没有赞助商给他寄新玩意儿。
sentences.en: He has thought about it, but he isn't on the cutting edge of technology, and he has no sponsors sending him new gadgets.

sentences.zh: 一切都是边摸索边拼凑，这档播客就是“地地道道的小白鼠”。
sentences.en: Everything is pieced together by trial and error as he goes, and this podcast is a "genuine guinea pig."

sentences.zh: 最近，这意味着大量的英语教学素材。
sentences.en: Lately, that has meant a lot of English teaching material.

sentences.zh: 让 AI 写雅思五分和七分的答案，出来的东西“一股子假味儿”，所以他一直在找真实的样本。
sentences.en: When he has AI write IELTS band 5 and band 7 answers, what comes out "reeks of fakeness," so he keeps looking for real samples.

sentences.zh: 生意做反了？
sentences.en: Running the business backwards?

sentences.zh: 他一直在听商业播客，也在读 AI 估值的文章。
sentences.en: He's been listening to business podcasts and reading articles about AI valuations.

sentences.zh: 让他震惊的是，有些公司完全靠风险投资活着，靠的是有钱人愿意亏钱，哪怕公司永远不盈利。
sentences.en: What shocked him is that some companies survive entirely on venture capital, relying on rich people willing to lose money, even if the company never turns a profit.

sentences.zh: 那 MBA 课上讲的“产品与市场匹配”呢？
sentences.en: So what about the "product-market fit" they teach in MBA classes?

sentences.zh: 看来他全做反了。
sentences.en: It looks like he's been doing it all backwards.

sentences.zh: 他应该包装成一家 AI 教育科技公司去找亿万富翁融资，而不是“像个平头百姓，一节课五美元地卖服务”。
sentences.en: He should package himself as an AI ed-tech company and raise money from billionaires, instead of "selling services at five dollars a lesson like some ordinary commoner."

sentences.zh: Meta 的 Muse：灵光一闪
sentences.en: Meta's Muse: A Flash of Inspiration

sentences.zh: 他现在大约在经营八个频道，其中三四个做英语教学。
sentences.en: He's now running about eight channels, three or four of which teach English.

sentences.zh: AI 把每期节目切成语法和词汇小知识点，再做成动画。
sentences.en: AI cuts each episode into small grammar and vocabulary points, then turns them into animations.

sentences.zh: 目前一条都还没发布，因为真正的难题是上传。
sentences.en: So far not a single one has been published, because the real challenge is uploading.

sentences.zh: 而 Muse 正好派上用场，这是 Meta 收购 Manus AI 后推出的 AI 智能体。
sentences.en: And that's exactly where Muse comes in handy, the AI agent Meta launched after acquiring Manus AI.

sentences.zh: 起初他不放心让它订机票。
sentences.en: At first he didn't trust it to book plane tickets.

sentences.zh: 后来他看到了它的连接器：Instagram、Facebook、Gmail 和 Google Drive。
sentences.en: Then he saw its connectors: Instagram, Facebook, Gmail and Google Drive.

sentences.zh: 于是有了这个想法：
sentences.en: That led to this idea:

sentences.zh: 整理： 照片由他自己按日期放进文件夹，因为 Claude 挑照片的眼光简直“一塌糊涂”。
sentences.en: Organizing: He sorts the photos into folders by date himself, because Claude's eye for choosing photos is simply "a total mess."

sentences.zh: 发布： Muse 从 Google Drive 取图，把轮播图发到对应的 Instagram 账号或 Facebook 主页。
sentences.en: Publishing: Muse pulls the images from Google Drive and posts the carousels to the matching Instagram account or Facebook page.

sentences.zh: 价格： 他目前用的是每月免费额度。
sentences.en: Price: For now he's using the free monthly allowance.

sentences.zh: GrokBot 试用结束后每月约 42 加元，除非能省下雇人时每小时 25 美元的开销，否则他不会掏这个钱。
sentences.en: GrokBot costs about 42 Canadian dollars a month after the trial ends, and he won't pay that unless it saves him the 25 US dollars an hour he'd spend hiring someone.

sentences.zh: 树叶终于开始变色了，可他眼里只有数据看板和闪个不停的终端光标。
sentences.en: The leaves have finally started to change color, but all he can see are dashboards and endlessly blinking terminal cursors.

sentences.zh: 我们等了许久的私人助理
sentences.en: The personal assistant we've waited so long for

sentences.zh: 他说：“我想把生活自动化，好发财，这样就不用在中国教英语了。”
sentences.en: He said: "I want to automate my life and get rich, so I won't have to teach English in China anymore."

sentences.zh: 今年他休了一个学期，本来有九个月让线上业务跑起来，结果没成，部分原因是产品不够有吸引力。
sentences.en: This year he took a semester off and had nine months to get his online business running, but it didn't work out, partly because the product wasn't appealing enough.

sentences.zh: Muse 还能标出需要处理的邮件，帮他跟进后续，而这正是他最“糟糕透顶”的地方。
sentences.en: Muse can also flag emails that need attention and help him follow up, which is exactly where he's at his most "terrible."

sentences.zh: 用它不需要编程，他那些 Zapier 自动化流程，如今都像老古董了。
sentences.en: Using it doesn't require any coding, and his Zapier automations now all look like antiques.

sentences.zh: “电脑终于变成了它本该有的样子。”
sentences.en: "The computer has finally become what it was always supposed to be."

sentences.zh: 万圣节朗读与 AI 做不到的事
sentences.en: Halloween readings and what AI can't do

sentences.zh: 上周他读了《美女瓦西丽莎与芭芭雅嘎》，接着读了果戈理的《圣约翰之夜》。
sentences.en: Last week he read "Vasilisa the Beautiful and Baba Yaga," and then Gogol's "St. John's Eve."

sentences.zh: 有几位听众很喜欢，所以他不觉得白费功夫。
sentences.en: A few listeners really liked them, so he doesn't feel it was wasted effort.

sentences.zh: 他想用古登堡计划的文本把这些朗读整理成电子书，也许卖两块钱。
sentences.en: He wants to use the Project Gutenberg texts to compile these readings into an ebook, and maybe sell it for two dollars.

sentences.zh: AI 智能体不会突然决定该讲哪个故事。
sentences.en: An AI agent won't suddenly decide which story to tell.

sentences.zh: 有哪档假惺惺、冷冰冰的机器人播客能火起来呢？
sentences.en: What fake, cold robot podcast could ever take off?

sentences.zh: 乔·罗根、《CEO 日记》、《All In》，“它们全是真人”。
sentences.en: Joe Rogan, The Diary of a CEO, All-In: "they're all real people."

sentences.zh: AI 真正的位置在幕后：转录、剪片段、做字幕。
sentences.en: AI's real place is behind the scenes: transcribing, cutting clips, making subtitles.

sentences.zh: 如今每月 30 美元就能搞定，以前请人剪一条一分钟的视频，他要花大约 6 美元。
sentences.en: These days it can all be handled for 30 dollars a month; before, when he hired someone to cut a one-minute video, it cost him about 6 dollars.

sentences.zh: 党的会议与股市
sentences.en: Party Meetings and the Stock Market

sentences.zh: 上周最热闹的，是中共二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议。
sentences.en: The biggest event last week was the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

sentences.zh: 他早就怀疑，这类会议和三月的两会一样，会通过点明重点产业来影响中国股市。
sentences.en: He had long suspected that meetings like this, like the Two Sessions in March, influence China's stock market by highlighting key industries.

sentences.zh: 于是他让 Claude 去翻公告，做出了“中国政策观察”看板。
sentences.en: So he had Claude go through the announcements and built a "China Policy Watch" dashboard.

sentences.zh: 他丢进去一篇文章，它就能找出约 25 只相关股票，并附上会议前后各 20 天的走势图。
sentences.en: He drops in an article, and it can find about 25 related stocks, along with charts of their price movements for 20 days before and after the meeting.

sentences.zh: 他的人工分析是：不少股票在会议前一两周上涨，之后又回落，不过并非全部如此。
sentences.en: His own manual analysis: many stocks rose in the week or two before a meeting and then fell back afterward, though not all of them did.

sentences.zh: 这次会议更多强调勤俭节约，所以食品药品安全被提到了，白酒也在其中，而贵州茅台作为送礼之选可不便宜。
sentences.en: This meeting put more emphasis on thrift, so food and drug safety got a mention, with baijiu among the items, and Kweichow Moutai, as a gift choice, is certainly not cheap.

sentences.zh: 再强调一次，这不是投资建议：“你的钱，你自己负责。”
sentences.en: Once again, this is not investment advice: "It's your money, and you're responsible for it."

sentences.zh: 十个看板和一份“正职”
sentences.en: Ten dashboards and one "real job"

sentences.zh: 两周做了十个看板，涵盖中国政策、YouTube 数据分析、他的体重、英语教学分镜、视频剪辑和 Substack 编辑。
sentences.en: In two weeks he built ten dashboards, covering Chinese policy, YouTube data analysis, his weight, English-teaching storyboards, video editing and Substack editing.

sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的本职工作也开始了评分校准，下周要考写作和口语期中考试。
sentences.en: Meanwhile, grading calibration has also started at his day job, and the writing and speaking midterm exams are next week.

sentences.zh: 校准用的练习是周五晚上八点才发来的。
sentences.en: The calibration exercises weren't sent out until eight o'clock on Friday night.

sentences.zh: 开什么玩笑？
sentences.en: Are you kidding me?

sentences.zh: 现在他还得准备明天的课。
sentences.en: And now he still has to prepare tomorrow's class.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: AI 终于有了电脑本该有的私人助理的样子，但点子、故事和最终决定权，仍然得来自人。
sentences.en: AI finally looks like the personal assistant computers were always meant to have, but ideas, stories, and the final say must still come from people.

sentences.zh: 好了，失陪一下，我还有一节课要备。
sentences.en: All right, please excuse me, I have a class to prepare for.

vocab.en: a flash of inspiration, light bulb moment
